-- FIXTURE: recorded output of `snow sql -D "user=AI_AGENT" -f identity.sql` against the same
-- deliberately misconfigured demo account: the "AI user" is a PERSON-type user with every granted
-- role active as a secondary role. Values are invented; shapes mirror DESCRIBE USER / SHOW GRANTS.
-- Statement 1: DESCRIBE USER AI_AGENT
+-------------------------+----------------------+---------+-------------------------------------------------+
| property                | value                | default | description                                     |
|-------------------------+----------------------+---------+-------------------------------------------------|
| NAME                    | AI_AGENT             | null    | Name                                            |
| LOGIN_NAME              | AI_AGENT_SVC         | null    | Login name of the user                          |
| TYPE                    | PERSON               | null    | User type                                       |
| DEFAULT_ROLE            | AI_AGENT             | null    | Primary principal of user session for privilege |
| DEFAULT_SECONDARY_ROLES | ["ALL"]              | null    | Secondary roles activated by default            |
| DISABLED                | false                | false   | Whether the user is disabled                    |
| RSA_PUBLIC_KEY_FP       | SHA256:fixturefpXXXX | null    | Fingerprint of user's RSA public key            |
+-------------------------+----------------------+---------+-------------------------------------------------+

-- Statement 2: SHOW GRANTS TO USER AI_AGENT
+-------------------------------+------+----------+------------+--------------+------------+
| created_on                    | role | granted_to | grantee_name | granted_by |
|-------------------------------+------+------------+--------------+------------|
| 2026-05-01 09:01:00.000 -0700 | AI_AGENT | USER   | AI_AGENT     | SYSADMIN   |
| 2025-11-02 12:00:00.000 -0700 | ANALYST  | USER   | AI_AGENT     | SYSADMIN   |
+-------------------------------+----------+--------+--------------+------------+
